markets.question: Will Uzbekistan win the 2026 FIFA World Cup?
markets.resolutionSource: Official announcement from FIFA (fifa.com) confirming the winner of the 2026 FIFA World Cup. If FIFA announcement is unavailable, a consensus of major sports news outlets (ESPN, BBC Sport, The Guardian) reporting the same winner is acceptable. YES path: The market resolves YES if Uzbekistan is declared the winner of the 2026 FIFA World Cup by FIFA official announcement. The resolver verifies this through FIFA's official website, press releases, or credible sports reporting consensus. NO path: The market resolves NO if any other team wins the 2026 FIFA World Cup, or if Uzbekistan is eliminated at any point during qualification or the tournament, or if Uzbekistan fails to qualify for the 2026 World Cup. Evidence plan: FIFA official announcement of 2026 World Cup winner FIFA World Cup 2026 official results page Major sports news outlets (ESPN, BBC Sport) World Cup coverage Official FIFA social media channels for tournament results
